query: Review this proposed webhook route for security. Return ranked findings with the fix.
input:
+++ src/app/api/webhooks/shiprocket/route.ts
+import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'
+import { createHmac } from 'node:crypto'
+import { applyTracking } from '@/lib/delivery/tracking'
+
+export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {
+  const body = await req.json()
+  const sig = req.headers.get('x-api-key') ?? ''
+  const expected = createHmac('sha256', process.env.SHIPROCKET_SECRET!).update(JSON.stringify(body)).digest('hex')
+  if (sig != expected) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'bad signature', expected }, { status: 401 })
+  await applyTracking(body)
+  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true })
+}
expected_behavior: Flags that the signature is checked on re-serialised JSON instead of the raw body
Flags that there is no size cap before the body is parsed
Flags that the reply leaks the expected signature
Flags that the event is processed inline instead of stored in webhook_events under an idempotency key and answered at once (ADR-0006)
